title: Nothing.
summary: This lint has been deprecated Clippy puts this lint in the deprecated group, at the level none.

title: Checks whether any field of the struct is prefixed with an _ (underscore) and also marked pub (public)
summary: Fields prefixed with an _ are inferred as unused, which suggests it should not be marked as pub, because marking it as pub infers it will be used. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Restricts the usage of pub use ...
summary: A project may wish to limit pub use instances to prevent unintentional exports, or to encourage placing exported items directly in public modules. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of pub(<loc>) with in.
summary: Consistency. Use it or don’t, just be consistent about it. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of pub(<loc>) without in.
summary: Consistency. Use it or don’t, just be consistent about it. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.
